channel.description: Latest articles from Hartford Business Journal (hartfordbusiness.com)

item.title: After denial, major CT insurer returns with new HQ plan
item.description: Greenwich planning officials are set to review Berkley Insurance’s latest headquarters proposal next week, roughly three months after rejecting the company’s prior expansion plans. The reinsurer has filed a new […]

item.title: Santander’s Webster deal targets $800M in savings, raising job and branch concerns
item.description: Banco Santander’s planned $12.3 billion acquisition of Webster Financial Corp. stands as one of the most consequential banking deals in Connecticut’s recent history.

item.title: 🔒 Fairfield medical training school relocates to larger Stratford location
item.description: A Fairfield-based medical training school has relocated to Stratford, leasing a significantly larger space for its training facility and offices. Cornerstone Medical Training Center signed a five-year lease, with renewal […]

item.title: 🔒 Hartford to review bike lanes amid business concerns
item.description: Hartford lawmakers will consider a proposal next week that could lead to changes in how bike lanes are designed and configured across the city, following complaints from small-business owners.

item.title: State launches new tool to improve race, ethnicity data in health care
item.description: Connecticut is taking a new step to improve how hospitals and doctors collect information about patients’ race, ethnicity and language.

item.title: Mohegan warns of prediction market threat amid tepid Q1 financial results
item.description: The Mohegan Tribal Gaming Authority is backing state efforts to crack down on prediction market operators that executives say are illegally encroaching on the tribes’ exclusive gaming rights, as the casino operator reported a first-quarter profit buoyed by a one-time accounting gain.

item.title: 🔒 Downtown Hartford apartment property listed for $1.45M
item.description: A six-unit multifamily property in downtown Hartford has been listed for sale with an asking price of $1.45 million.

item.title: Frisbie’s Dairy Barn ice cream shop coming to Blue Back Square
item.description: Anyone with a sweet tooth who lamented the closing of a chocolate shop in West Hartford’s Blue Back Square can now look forward to an alternative opening in the same spot.

item.title: 🔒 UConn issues new guidance on potential immigration enforcement visits to campus
item.description: The University of Connecticut has issued new guidance to students, faculty and staff on how to respond if federal immigration agents appear on campus, though the university said it has received no reports of planned or confirmed visits by Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers.

item.title: 🔒 Eversource unveils $26.5B capital plan, boosting infrastructure spending
item.description: Eversource has boosted its five-year capital plan to $26.5B as it ramps up grid and gas system upgrades, posts sharply higher earnings and signals confidence in improving regulatory conditions in Connecticut.
